findings.text: kanban/tickets/5.2.budget-stop.md: ticket 5.2 is done but the finding homed here from 5.1 is unaddressed in its Log: AC-4 test asserts only two substrings; tree, questions, plan page, Gate 1 unpinned. tests/test_grill_skill.py:126
findings.consequence: Anyone trusting the board to close out findings gets a done ticket carrying an unanswered one. The grill skill's prompt shape stays half-pinned, so a later edit can drop the tree, questions or plan page without a test noticing.
